name: Santa María de Guía de Gran Canaria (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over sky blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Santa María de Guía de Gran Canaria (a ship and a castle on blue and red, with a scroll).
history: The flag of Santa María de Guía de Gran Canaria is divided into two horizontal stripes, the upper white and the lower sky blue; the municipal arms were approved by the Government of the Canary Islands on 15 April 1992.

features.role: Santa María de Guía arms — ship and castle, with scroll
